boundary: Local complete Mini API production image over real HTTP, 512 MiB cgroup, local MEMORY_TEST configuration; no cloud, phone, or deployment
setup: Mounted an initially empty host directory read-only over /app/workers/miniapp-api/assets/celestial-names, then copied the two unchanged published assets into that host directory while the same service process stayed running.
limits: Demonstrates retry after the alias package becomes available in one long-lived local process; it does not model an atomic cloud rollout or mutable production asset policy.
The Mini Program UI retry, Canvas/WXML composition, Android/iOS, and sustained production capacity remain unverified.
